system.description:
Opal's most aggressive duelling school — attack as defence, momentum as armour.

  • Committed Blade: Relentless Assault starts from the second hit as normal, but the bonus is +2d4 instead of +1d4 — committing to a target pays off more, but you still have to earn it.
  • Noble Rivalry: Advantage on Intimidation checks and on checks related to Opal's duelling culture or noble rivalry.

features.name: Committed Blade
features.description: Relentless Assault starts from the second hit as normal, but the bonus is +2d4 instead of +1d4 — committing to a target pays off more, but you still have to earn it.

activities.name: Relentless Assault (2d4)
activities.text: Relentless Assault's bonus is +2d4 instead of +1d4, from the second hit against the same target as normal.

rules.when: each hit after the first on the same target this round (with Relentless Assault, total +2d4)

features.name: Noble Rivalry
features.description: Advantage on Intimidation checks and on checks related to Opal's duelling culture or noble rivalry.

rules.when: Opal's duelling culture or noble rivalry
